description: One call, several formats: rendered HTML content and a base64 screenshot (plus optional Markdown and accessibility tree), with the page's status and title. Price: $0.005 a call (3 free calls a day without an API key).

deliver.description: {store, name?}: keep the snapshot's screenshot in file storage

formats.description: At least two of: content, screenshot, markdown, accessibilityTree (default content+screenshot)

html.description: HTML to render instead of a URL.

screenshotOptions.description: Puppeteer screenshot options for the snapshot's screenshot format

url.description: The page to snapshot (https). Set url or html, not both.

name: snapshot
title: One call, several formats
